item.title: Iga Ueno: Castle and Home of the Ninja — Guide
item.description: The mountain-ringed basin of Iga was one of the two great cradles of ninja tradition, home to the Iga-ryu school whose spies and saboteurs shaped Japan’s shadow history — and the town of Iga Ueno celebrates that legacy fully. Its centrepiece is the Iga-ryu Ninja Museum, a real thatched farmhouse riddled with hidden doors, reversible walls, secret passages and weapon caches demonstrated by costumed guides, paired with live shows of shuriken-throwing and ninja weaponry.
